annotations.title: Notified national measures for an EU act

description: The measures member states (and the UK) notified to the Commission for an EU act (CELEX sector 3, e.g. a directive), by country, from the Publications Office's Cellar records. A notification is not a finding that the measure transposes the act, or transposes it completely; the result's note states this. Every plan. On BUSINESS+, for live countries only, it also shows which measures LexAPI holds (id, resolved) and adds relations recorded by the national source (provenance "source"). termsRequired: true = the national-source terms are not yet accepted in the dashboard. source.cellar.attribution is the attribution for the Cellar data and must be kept with republished content (Terms). Output is bounded (limit, ~40,000 characters); more gives the next offset. Cost: 5 credits per call or page.

celexNumber.description: CELEX number of the EU act, e.g. 32016R0679.

jurisdictions.description: Only these countries, e.g. ["es","cz"] (EL = Greece, UK = United Kingdom); default all 28.

offset.description: Skip this many measures (value given in the previous result's more).

resolvedOnly.description: Only measures resolved to a document LexAPI holds (BUSINESS+, live countries).
